claim: Modern operational hypotheses joining historical strength clauses to neutral self-reports; not six verbatim historical personality predictions.
question_policy: Reuse original wording and context. Show required antecedents, allow skipping, correction and free text. No answer becomes evidence automatically. Participant-confirmed interpretation is required. Other existing survey answers can be imported.

domains.label: Sharing understanding
domains.affirmative: I commonly explain what I have understood so another person can use it.
domains.negative: I generally keep that understanding to myself rather than explain or translate it for others.
domains.limit: Do not infer teaching ability, successful communication, or a reusable method from one offer to help. Conditional habitual self-reports retain their conditions.

domains.label: Solitude and privacy
domains.affirmative: I regularly seek time alone, privacy, or a deliberate break from ordinary social activity.
domains.negative: I generally do not seek solitude or privacy and normally prefer continuing company instead.
domains.limit: Imposed isolation, a single tired day, and choosing spiritual retreat are not interchangeable. Omitted information is unknown.

domains.label: Romantic connection
domains.affirmative: Romantic attraction or wanting romantic pair-bonding is a recurring part of my experience.
domains.negative: I normally do not experience romantic attraction or desire romantic pair-bonding.
domains.limit: Single relationship difficulty, privacy, no dating experience, friendship, and sexual desire do not determine this code. No sexual-orientation label is inferred.

domains.label: Influencing a shared plan
domains.affirmative: I regularly try to influence plans through discussion, argument, or adapting how I explain something.
domains.negative: I normally avoid trying to persuade and do not generally engage in influencing plans that way.
domains.limit: Capacity, preference, frequency, audience adaptation, and success are different. Code only the stated tendency; do not credit success from effort or infer inability from preference.

domains.label: Entering a role
domains.affirmative: I commonly enter roles because others recognize what I can contribute and invite or appoint me.
domains.negative: I commonly enter roles through my own initiation rather than others inviting or appointing me.
domains.limit: One imagined shared-meal response may be insufficient. Mixed routes remain mixed. Do not infer occupational success, status, or leadership capacity.

unscored_inherited_domain.reason: The inherited range/capacity label has no single affirmative behavioral pole. It is not silently signed or counted as 'everyone has work limits'. The retained Saturn hypothesis uses the inherited solitude/privacy bridge only.

rules.hypothesis: Present clause supports the affirmative sharing-understanding pole.
Present clause supports the affirmative solitude/privacy pole.
Present clause supports the affirmative romantic-connection pole.
Present clause supports at least one of the two inherited alternatives; explicit contradiction requires both to be contradicted.
Present clause supports the affirmative invitation/appointment pole.
Present clause supports the affirmative romantic-connection pole.

scoring.repeated_construct_warning: Romantic connection can affect three clause votes. Raw testimony stacking is the primary owner-requested arm; those votes are not statistically independent.

primary_test: 999 seeded century-random decoys, then compare the separately revealed actual instant. No target-aware optimization or date-proximity tie-break.
